cases.template: Does the summary name the selected CDC question?
Does the summary identify the selected data unit?
Does the summary identify the selected estimate type?
Does the summary include the selected start year?
Does the summary include the selected end year?
Does the summary name every selected location?
Does the summary name the selected population category?
Does the summary name the selected population group?
Does the summary clearly describe the selected time window?
Does the summary report the number of matching CDC records?
Does the summary report how many matching records contain numeric values?
Does the summary report whether values are missing?
Does the summary accurately describe observed-year coverage by location?
Does the summary identify missing years without treating them as zero?
Does the summary state which years are shared across selected locations?
Does the summary describe the number of returned location/population series?
Does the summary report each series' first year and mean?
Does the summary report each series' latest year and mean?
Does the summary report each series' highest annual mean and year?
Does the summary characterize first-to-last direction without causal claims?

scoring.pass: A deterministic criterion must find the required exact selected value(s) or expected response facts together with the specified context. A keyword alone is insufficient where a value or relationship is required.
scoring.api_calls: Reuse the response from the user's ordinary graph-and-summary request; no additional API request or evaluator prompt.
scoring.baseline: Filters-only baseline answers B01-B09 from submitted controls and receives no credit for evidence-dependent B10-B20.
scoring.limitations: Expected response facts currently come from the same structured API response, so this is not independent CDC source validation. Deterministic text checks can miss paraphrases and contradictions.
